headline: Outcome of Board Meeting — Unaudited Ind AS Financial Results for Q1 FY27 (quarter ended Jun 30, 2026)
summary: Q1 FY27 (standalone): Revenue ₹1,420 Cr (+7.9% YoY, +13.4% QoQ); Operating EBITDA ₹289 Cr (-1.9% YoY, margin 20.3%); PAT ₹193 Cr (-4.0% YoY, +7.9% QoQ).
raw_text: Outcome of Board Meeting — Unaudited Ind AS Financial Results for Q1 FY27 (quarter ended Jun 30, 2026)

enrichment.highlights: Basis: Standalone · Normalised from ₹ lakh (Page 2) · EBITDA derived from schedule iii

derivation.basis_note: Standalone Unaudited Ind AS Financial Results (PDF p. 2, reported in ₹ Lakhs; normalised ÷100 to ₹ crore). Confirmed on PDF Page 3, Note 9: 'The Company has no subsidiary/ associate/ joint venture company(ies) as at June 30, 2026' — therefore Page Industries has no consolidated financial statement.
derivation.revenue_definition: Revenue from Operations (net of sales incentives per Note 4) = ₹1,42,044.53 Lakhs ÷ 100 = ₹1,420.45 Cr.
derivation.ebitda_formula: Operating Profit (Revenue ₹1,42,044.53L − Total Expenses ₹1,17,248.86L = ₹24,795.67L) + Finance Costs (₹1,243.33L) + Depreciation & Amortisation (₹2,861.33L) = ₹28,900.33 Lakhs ÷ 100 = ₹289.00 Cr (20.35% margin).
derivation.pbt_basis: Profit Before Tax (no exceptional items in Q1 FY27; FY26 full year had ₹3,500.42L New Labour Code exceptional item per Note 7) = ₹25,857.13 Lakhs ÷ 100 = ₹258.57 Cr.
derivation.pat_basis: Total Profit for the period (100% Standalone entity, no non-controlling interest) = ₹19,280.62 Lakhs ÷ 100 = ₹192.81 Cr.
